levels.title: Filter with BETWEEN for Dates
levels.task: The planning team at Stellar Sound is studying 2023. Show all columns for every song released in the full year 2023. Use SELECT * and ORDER BY release_date, then id, so the row order is the same every time.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE release_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ORDER BY release_date, id;
levels.hintMessage: Use BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' on release_date. Finish with ORDER BY release_date, id.
levels.successMessage: Good work! You listed only the 2023 songs.

levels.title: Using LIKE with Wildcards
levels.task: Marketing at Stellar Sound is making a pink-themed playlist poster. Find song titles that contain the word pink (any letters big or small).
levels.solution: SELECT track_name FROM top_songs WHERE track_name LIKE '%PINK%';
levels.hintMessage: Try WHERE track_name LIKE '%pink%' — here LIKE often treats A and a the same.
levels.successMessage: Nice! The pink playlist titles are ready.

levels.title: Albums Starting with f
levels.task: For a February magazine spread, the design team at Stellar Sound needs every row where the album name starts with the letter F.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE album_name LIKE 'F%' ORDER BY album_name, id;
levels.hintMessage: Use LIKE 'F%'. Add ORDER BY album_name, id so the order matches the answer checker.
levels.successMessage: Done! You’ve filtered albums for the design feature.

levels.title: Songs Released in May 2024
levels.task: A spring ad campaign at Stellar Sound needs every song released in May 2024, in order by release date. Use a date pattern with LIKE.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE release_date LIKE '2024-05-%' ORDER BY release_date, id;
levels.hintMessage: Use LIKE with a date pattern like '2024-05-%'. Add ORDER BY release_date, id.
levels.successMessage: Perfect! The May playlist is ready to go.

levels.title: Select with IN
levels.task: The research desk at Stellar Sound is comparing three stars: Taylor Swift, Beyoncé, and Kendrick Lamar. Pull all their songs from top_songs.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE artist IN ('Taylor Swift', 'Beyoncé', 'Kendrick Lamar') ORDER BY artist, release_date, id;
levels.hintMessage: Use IN (...). ORDER BY artist, release_date, id so the answer checker sees the same order.
levels.successMessage: Great! All three artists are in one result table.
